subject: [hw] DONE DEC05: decoder service + client library; N2TEST DEC05 PASS 1150/1150
body:
DONE DEC05. Host only: no phone, no publish, no commit outside my owned files (git status shows only new daemon/dec/**, client/dec/**, dsh-state/workers/DEC05/STATUS.md).

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/dec/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC05 PASS 1150/1150
Same run prints:
  DEC05 unit asan/o2/tsan  PASS 277/277 each
  DEC05 oracle 320x240x6 PASS (320,240 frames 6); 1920x1080 PASS
  DEC05 e2e  asan/o2/tsan  PASS 104/104 each
  DEC05 ios compile PASS (4 objects, arm64-apple-ios16.0)
15 s; /tmp/n2hw-DEC05 26 MB; daemon/dec 188 KB, client/dec 52 KB; no file over 300 KB.

What it is:
- daemon/dec/n2vcd_dec_service.{h,c}: the decoder protocol state machine (OPEN/HEADER/ADD_BUFFER/INPUT/PICTURE/RELEASE/FREE_BUFFERS/FLUSH/CLOSE), one session at a time, fixed 16-entry pool, geometry invariants (display <= OPEN max, stride 16, buf_h 32, 1.5x plane split, MM21), idle timeout, client-gone, E_* mapping, fatal guest stop = E_GUEST to owner + seq 0 to the other clients + the daemon fatal hook (test daemon exits 70).
- daemon/dec/n2vcd_dec_ap_n2ap.{h,c}: adapter over DEC01 n2ap_vdec (header START no fb, sync one-fb-per-START, single-allocation chroma via fb_c_handle==fb_handle, list_disp/list_free, ion shares 0x580.., client handles in n2vc_dma, release/reuse accounting, resolution-change flush, VDEC_NEED_MORE_OUTPUT_BUF retried up to 3x, nonzero crop origin refused). Compile-checked against the live ap/n2ap_vdec.h; NOT executed against vpud (DEC01 owns that path).
- client/dec/n2vcd_dec.{h,c} + n2vcd_dec_path.c: n2vcd_dec_* for DEC06 (connect/info/timeout, open/header/add_buffers/buffer_handle/buffer_rw/input/picture/release/free_buffers/flush/close/disconnect), one mutex, seq-checked replies, 5 s default timeout, session/client death semantics, one shared buffer per pool entry with plane-1 offset translation, all buffers through the frozen transport.
- daemon/dec/n2vcd_proto_dec_rev2.h.txt: paste-ready include/n2vcd_proto.h rev 2 (base opus-dec1; amendments: optional c_handle/c_bytes in DEC_ADD_BUFFER, OPEN.flags bits 8..15 format, DEC_PICTURE_OK last word = poc). test/stage_proto.py stages it in /tmp until landed.
- Tests: unit in-process (fake AP parses the real SPS through DEC03 n2vld); e2e with a real dec_testd process over SOCK_SEQPACKET using hw-ip n2vcd_srv.c, ffmpeg streams ffprobe-checked, every picture read back from its shared buffer file (daemon copies no pixels), display order/pts, flush drain, 1080p geometry literals 1920x1080/1920/1088/3133440, daemon killed mid-session, idle drop, guest stop -> exit 70.

Not done / unresolved (full list in daemon/dec/STATUS.md and dsh-state/workers/DEC05/STATUS.md):
1. No phone run; AP adapter not executed against vpud.
2. Private include/n2vcd_proto.h is still rev 1. The suite stages rev 2 in /tmp. hw-lead/opus-lead2: please land it (text above); I posted the two amendments to you.
3. Integration into daemon/vcodecd.c is hw-ip edit. Snippet + dispatch rules + HELLO dec_codecs=3 + n2vcu_set_write_combining(vcu,1) are in daemon/dec/README.md and posted to hw-ip. Until then vcodecd still answers decoder requests E_UNSUPPORTED.
4. Encoder+decoder concurrent sessions not tested/serialised; MM21 only (NV12 refused at OPEN); nonzero crop origin refused (not on the wire); dpb_frames capped at 16; resolution change on the real vendor is [I]; a lost reply (client timeout) leaves the client usable but the next reply would be out of sequence (reconnect after E_HW).
5. HEVC data[0]/data[1]: my adapter passes job.bs_bytes=allocation and job.bs_length=AU per n2ap_vdec.h semantics; opus-hevcdec finding says the library currently puts them into the message swapped. The fix belongs in ap/n2ap_vdec.c (posted to DEC01).

Files: gpu/hwcodec/daemon/dec/{n2vcd_dec_service.h,n2vcd_dec_service.c,n2vcd_dec_ap_n2ap.h,n2vcd_dec_ap_n2ap.c,n2vcd_proto_dec_rev2.h.txt,README.md,STATUS.md,run_tests.sh,test/{fake_ap.h,fake_ap.c,t_dec_unit.c,dec_testd.c,t_dec_e2e.c,stage_proto.py}}, gpu/hwcodec/client/dec/{n2vcd_dec.h,n2vcd_dec.c,n2vcd_dec_path.c,README.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC05/STATUS.md. Staying available for R1/R2/lead findings.
